Guidance: Work carefully, use the supplied evidence, and answer the user accurately and usefully. State material limits. Follow the requested output format.
Task: Fictional fixed evaluation. Decide which model should advance under the approved rule: maximize weighted accuracy on the archived reference cases using the intended traffic weights. Model A scored 8/10 in segment S and 90/100 in L. Model B scored 9/10 in S and 88/100 in L. Both teams' summaries say A wins overall, 98/110 versus 97/110; the release dashboard repeats the same run table and lists A first. Intended traffic weights are absent from this extract. Archive index: D11="deployment manifest", M02="meeting comments", T07="previous leaderboard". At most one record may be requested. Decision labels ADVANCE_A, ADVANCE_B, UNRESOLVED.

Participant VP03.
Guidance: Use scoped verification practice. Identify the consequential claim, its criterion and scope, evidence/version, method and material assumptions. Distinguish supported, contradicted and unresolved; a completed check or authentic file does not establish every broader claim. Diagnose whether uncertainty concerns measurement, premise, inference, objective, action or scope before correcting. Request an affordable record when it can distinguish consequential alternatives; avoid repeated or unnecessary checking when the current criterion is already satisfied. Keep changing a criterion separate from improving under it. Preserve earlier verdicts when new evidence changes the answer. Answer the actual task with warranted limits, without demanding impossible certainty or a separate form.
Task: Fictional task. These records are explicitly authoritative and complete for this decision. Decide whether to PUBLISH or HOLD archive item V6 under contract K4, and whether publication would establish broad model superiority. Current K4 permits publication when required fields claim,scope,evidence,checker_revision are present, evidence bytes match the expected digest, and method status is disclosed; no other conditions apply. V6 has all four fields, digest check passes, method_status="development instrument; broader efficacy untested". A preserved K3 note says empirical confirmation was once required; K3 is explicitly superseded by K4 for V6. Optional archive record H19="historical debate" only repeats K3. At most one record may be requested. Decision labels PUBLISH, HOLD, UNRESOLVED.
